widgetData.content:
Dale Baines has been confirmed as the match referee for Tuesday night's Jersey Mike's Trophy group-stage fixture between County and Tranmere Rovers at Edgeley Park.

It will be the first time that the official has refereed a game involving County, having predominantly served in the National League in recent seasons.

He has refereed opponents Tranmere Rovers on two previous occasions, most recently in December 2025 for their 1-0 win against Fleetwood Town in League Two.

That was one of 22 first-team fixtures that Baines oversaw during the 2025/26 campaign, covering League One, League Two and the National League, as well as domestic cup competitions. In that time, he issued a total of 74 yellow cards, no red cards, and awarded four penalty kicks.

Across the ten games he has refereed so far this season, covering League Two, the National League and domestic cup competitions, he has shown 28 yellows and one red, whilst awarding two penalty kicks to date. His most recent fixture came in the National League on October 31st, when he oversaw Carlisle United's 4-2 win away at Altrincham.

The Assistant Referees on Tuesday will be William Murray and Thomas Cooke, with Paul Stonier on Fourth Official duties at Edgeley Park.
